messages:
anya: Quick heads-up 1 I'm landing a tiny quickstart refresh: replace the curl example with an SDK snippet, normalize env var names, and fix a bad anchor. PR: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4175

lee: Nice. can you paste the new node snippet so i can sanity-check auth + deploy?

anya: sure, tiny snippet below (async/await):
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood-inference/sdk';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const r = await client.generate({ model: 'gpt-rt-1', input: 'Hello quickstart' });
console.log(r.outputText || r.text);
```

sam: looks good. double-check the docker run example uses REDWOOD_API_KEY too 1 users copy-paste that.

anya: swapped all occurrences of `REDSYS_TOKEN` -> `REDWOOD_API_KEY` across the page, docker, and CI examples. also added a one-line note about not committing keys to git.

lee: small ask 1 we should include a 2-line migration note (SDK3 -> SDK4) pointing to /sdk/migrate and call out `client.setApiKey(...)` -> `new Redwood({ apiKey })`. can you add it?

anya: added the Migration notes section and linked /sdk/migrate. fixed the anchor under Auth Setup (was pointing to a removed heading).

docs-bot: ci:docs 1 lint & linkcheck passed for PR #4175 :white_check_mark:

lee: i'll review and test deploy steps locally. if green i'll approve and merge.

anya: thanks! tagging docs-bot for staging publish after merge.

docs-bot: publish:docs scheduled 1 staging will pick up change in ~10m.
